title: Game no Tatsujin 2
overview:
The culmination of table games, finally here.

Game no Tatsujin 2 gathers seven classic table games on one disc: shogi, go, renju, mahjong, chess, Place (a Reversi-style disc-flipping game) and backgammon. Pick a game and play against a computer opponent at your chosen level, or challenge a friend.

- Seven games in one
- 1 or 2 players
- Shuttle Mouse compatible
- Memory backup
